chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Imam prays the Dhuhr prayer on the day of departure in Mecca.

key_terms.بِمَكَّةَ: In Mecca (specifying the location distinct from Mina)
key_terms.يَوْمَ النَّفْرِ: The day of departure (specifically referring to the 8th or 9th of Dhu al-Hijjah when pilgrims leave Mina)

ai.seo_question: When and where should the Dhuhr prayer be performed on the day of departure from Mina during Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* clarifies the specific legal ruling for the Dhuhr prayer during the first departure (*Al-Nafar al-Awwal*) from Mina, establishing that it is performed in Mecca rather than Mina. This distinction is crucial in Shia jurisprudence for differentiating between the two departure phases of Hajj, ensuring the pilgrim's ritual validity aligns with the Prophet's practice as transmitted through Imam al-Sadiq. It underscores the precision required in Hajj rituals, where location and timing directly impact the correctness of the prayer.
